load_model_from_pretrained: load a pretrained causal language model using AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained with dtype auto
configure_quantization_modifier: configure a QuantizationModifier with NVFP4A16 scheme targeting Linear layers and ignoring lm_head
apply_oneshot_quantization: apply oneshot quantization to a model using a QuantizationModifier recipe
generate_text_with_quantized_model: generate text from a quantized model using model.generate with max_new_tokens
save_quantized_model_pretrained: save a quantized model to disk in compressed-tensors format using save_pretrained
